_comment: Explicit locality → rate-list mapping, tried before any name matching. Fill a locality in here when the published list names it differently, splits it across several villages, or does not name it at all (the newer Ayodhya corridors are named by their older road descriptions in the 2025 list). An empty array means 'not yet mapped' and the dry run will keep reporting the locality as unmatched. Run `npm run rates:import-list -- --dry-run` to see candidate ids for each.

faizabad-road.note: A corridor, not a village: the two फैजाबाद rows in the list are फैजाबाद ग्रामीण and मांझामूडाडीहाफैजाबाद, neither of which is this road. The list prices it through Sadar segments 59, 60 and 61 (अकबरपुर-फैजाबाद रोड), all at 12,300 ₹/sq m, which are mapped here. rateRowIds stays empty on purpose, so the locality keeps its own circleRate until someone decides which villages the corridor should quote.

civil-lines.note: The list spells it सिविल लाइन्स (s524); the locality record uses सिविल लाइंस. Same place — Sadar, ward सिविल लाइन, urban. Deliberately ONLY this row, not the ward. सिविल लाइन is a large administrative ward holding ten rows from 8,900 to 72,800 ₹ per sq m, and the other nine are distinct colonies and schemes in their own right (अवधविहार, कौशलपुरी, जे बी पुरम, ट्रान्सपोर्ट नगर, नययर कालोनी, वैभव कॉम्प्लेक्स, हौसिला नगर, करम अली का पुरवा, मोदहा सरपतिया). Several deserve their own locality records rather than being folded into Civil Lines. This locality is live, so every row mapped here becomes indexable.

ram-path.note: Confirmed absent: राम पथ returns nothing across all five lists, as do धर्म पथ and भक्ति पथ. The corridor runs Sahadatganj → Naya Ghat and the 2025 list prices that ground as ordinary segments under their older descriptions — 6 (चौक → बेनीगंज), 7 (बेनीगंज → श्रीराम हास्पिटल) and 8 (श्रीराम हास्पिटल → नयाघाट) lie along it. Not mapped, because stitching a named corridor out of segments the list never connects is my geography, not the list's. Someone who knows the alignment should pick the stretches.

dharma-path.note: Confirmed absent: धर्म पथ returns nothing in any of the five lists. Runs from Ram Path towards the Ram Janmabhoomi complex; the list prices that ground under older descriptions without naming the corridor. Same reasoning as ram-path.

bhakti-path.note: Confirmed absent: भक्ति पथ returns nothing, and neither does शृंगार (Shringar Haat, its western end). Segment 69 (अर्जुनदास जी के मंदिर → कनक भवन के पृष्ठ भाग → राम कोट) is the nearest description in the list but is not the same route, so it is not mapped.

devkali.note: The list splits Devkali across the municipal boundary: देवकाली अं.न.पा. (s225, अन्तर्गत नगर पालिका, inside, urban) and देवकालीBNP (s226, बाहर नगर पालिका, outside, semi-urban). Both are this locality. छोटी देवकाली (s165) is deliberately NOT included: different ward (अवध खास, not हवेली अवध), different rate tier, and a distinct name — it is its own revenue entry, not part of Devkali. The duplicate locality record 'deokali' was merged into this one; /ayodhya/deokali/ 301s here via public/_redirects.

ranopali.note: Same municipal split as Devkali: रानोपाली ANP (s425, inside, urban) and रानोपाली BNP (s426, outside, semi-urban). Both are this locality; the page shows the range across them. s426 carries the same figures as देवकालीBNP, which is the outside-municipality band for the हवेली अवध pargana rather than a Ranopali-specific rate.

ayodhya-bypass-nh-27.note: Segments 55 (बाईपास रोड-सहादतगंज बाईपास से देवकाली चौराहे तक) and 56 (देवकाली बाईपास से अयोध्या तक) are the only two that price the bypass carriageway itself rather than using बाईपास as an endpoint landmark, which is what segments 1, 5, 52, 53, 57 and 64 do. Together they trace Sahadatganj → Devkali → Ayodhya, which is this bypass. Both at 22,100 ₹/sq m across all ten village rows, all mapped. The list never prints a highway number, so the NH-27 in the locality id is the record's claim, not the list's. Segments are shared with devkali and ranopali, which front the same stretches.

airport-road.note: CORRECTION: the previous note here said no एयरपोर्ट row or segment exists. That was wrong — Sadar segment 73 reads "अयोध्या-इलाहाबाद मार्ग से एयरपोर्ट अयोध्या मुख्यद्वार तक" and names the airport outright. It prices the approach road at 27,700 ₹/sq m across all four villages it crosses (गंजा, पूरा हुसैनखां, मलिकपुर, चांदपुर हरवंश), all mapped. rateRowIds stays empty: this is a corridor, and no row is named for the road itself.

lucknow-road.note: A corridor with no village row of its own. Sadar segment 5 (सर्किट हाउस → लखनऊ रोड बाईपास, 33,200–37,000 ₹/sq m) and segment 26 (लखनऊ रोड टी.वी. टावर चौराहा → डी.एम. बंगला, 33,200) name it explicitly. Milkipur also has a segment 5, on the Ayodhya–Raebareli road; it is not this one.

gosaiganj.note: The list spells it गोशाईगंज and groups the whole town under one ward, टाउन एरिया गोशाईगंज: twelve mohalla rows (कटरा ×6, गोशाईगंज ×3, तेलियागढ़ ×3) that all carry identical figures — 7,700/8,500/9,300 ₹ per sq m, shop 48,200, agri 107 — because the town area is a single rate band. All twelve are mapped, so the page shows the town rather than an arbitrary three of its mohallas. NOTE: the locality record said tehsil Bikapur, which is wrong — no गोशाईगंज row exists outside Sadar in any of the five lists, and the single Bikapur mention is a road heading towards it, priced for तारून. Corrected to Sadar here.

bikapur-road.note: Two unrelated villages are both called बीकापुर: bikapur-1221 in the Bikapur SRO (12,000 ₹/sq m, the town this road runs to) and sadar-s324 in Sadar (2,100, a small rural village that happens to share the name). The locality's own tehsil is Bikapur, so only the first is mapped. Segments 1 (NH Ayodhya–Prayagraj, 32,000) and 4 (Bikapur–Jana road, 26,000) carry its frontage.

masodha.note: Unchanged in substance: the only मसौधा in the five lists is खानपुर मसौधा (sohawal-1029, 9,500 ₹/sq m), and mapping it asserts that Khanpur Masodha and Masodha are one place. The supporting detail is stronger than the earlier note allowed — Sohawal segment 7 reads "खानपुर मसौधा में फैजाबाद तहसील की सीमा से लेप्रोसी मिशन तक (फैजाबाद से इलाहाबाद रोड पर)", which puts the stretch on the Faizabad–Allahabad road starting at the Sadar boundary, and the locality sits on that road at 26.74/82.15. That is consistent with the two being the same place across a tehsil line, but it is still inference from a shared name element. Confirm on the ground, then map row sohawal-1029 and that segment together.

barun-bypass.note: CORRECTION: the previous note said बरुण appears nowhere in the five lists. It does appear, spelled बारून — Milkipur segment 6 is "अयोध्या से रायबरेली मार्ग पर देवरिया (बारून बाजार) में तमसा पुल से राजकीय पशुचिकित्सालय तक", 26,000 ₹/sq m through देवरिया and खिहारन. Still not mapped, because that is a bazar inside Deoria in Milkipur tehsil, while this record is a bypass in Sadar at 26.745/82.135. A bazar on a through road is not a bypass, and the tehsils do not agree. Either confirm the two are the same corridor, or correct the record.

mahobra.note: CORRECTION: the previous note said महोबरा appears nowhere in any of the five lists and the locality might have to be dropped. It appears eleven times — the list spells it मोहबरा, not महोबरा. Segment 66 runs टेढ़ी बाजार → मोहबरा बाजार → लखनऊ-गोरखपुर राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग and segment 70 मानस भवन चौराहा → मोहबरा चौराहा, which between them pin the place east of Tedhi Bazar towards the NH, matching the record's 26.785/82.23. Both segments price every village on them identically at 24,100 ₹/sq m, so the frontage figure does not depend on which row is read. No rateRowIds: Mohbara is a bazar inside a revenue village, not a village row of its own, and naming आशिफबाग as that village would be a guess.

bhadarsa-road.note: Bhadarsa is split inside/outside the town area, the same pattern as Devkali and Ranopali: भदरसा टाउन अन्दर व समस्त मोहल्ले (s1093, 10,600 ₹/sq m) and भदरसा टाउन बाहर (s1094, 8,850). Both mapped. कल्याण भदरसा (sohawal-1025, 7,800) is deliberately excluded — a separately named revenue village, as छोटी देवकाली is to Devkali. NOTE: the locality record says tehsil Sadar, but every भदरसा row in the five lists is in Sohawal; corrected to Sohawal.

rudauli-road.note: CORRECTION: the previous note said no रुदौली segment exists. The Rudauli list is full of them — the spelling is रूदौली with a long ू, and twelve of its twenty-three segments read सडक रूदौली से … सीमा तक. Milkipur segment 9 is also a Rudauli road (मिल्कीपुर से रूदौली जनपदीय मार्ग). None of them is this record, which places Rudauli Road in Sohawal at 26.775/82.09: the Rudauli segments radiate from Rudauli town some 30 km west, and no Sohawal segment names Rudauli at all. Decide which stretch of the Ayodhya–Rudauli road this locality actually is, then map that.

kumarganj-road.note: Milkipur segments 2 and 3 both name कुमारगंज: segment 2 is the अयोध्या-रायबरेली मार्ग through Kumarganj (चन्द्रबली सिंह महिला पी0जी0 कालेज गेट → पावर हाउस कुमारगंज) and segment 3 runs कुमारगंज → घोड़वल on the district road. Both at 26,000 ₹/sq m, all four village rows mapped. This is the same standard used for lucknow-road: a segment that names the road is the road. NOTE: the locality record said tehsil Bikapur, but every कुमारगंज segment is in Milkipur and Kumarganj town is in Milkipur tehsil; corrected to Milkipur, as was done for Bhadarsa.

sahadatganj.note: सहादतगंज is a ward of eight rows. The importer already matched s517 (सहादतगंज, 10,500 ₹/sq m) on its own by exact name; this alias adds the two rows whose parenthetical marks them as टोला inside the mohalla — s91 (कुम्हार टोला (सहादतगंज), 8,900) and s106 (कोरी टोला (सहादतगंज), 10,200) — so the page shows the range within Sahadatganj rather than one row. The other five rows in the ward (घसियारी मण्डी, बढई का पुरवा, बुचनीगंज, मस्तान का पुरवा, सलारपुर) are separately named places and are excluded, the same rule applied to सिविल लाइन. Segment 5 (सर्किट हाउस → लखनऊ रोड बाईपास, spelled सआदतगंज there, 33,200) is its frontage. The derived headline is unchanged at 10,500/49,200, since s517 was already the highest of the three.
